1937, April
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 182 Cont.
Apr. 23 John J Uller - 58 - Wants success in undertaking ... to pay honest debts contracted with best of intentions when everything went flush .... N.B. Once a millionaire - this man was threatened with the loss of his saintly wife. She had been four days unconscious - her eyes set with mouth open.
Page 183
Apr. 27 Matthew Carey - 44 - Strep infection ... had 8 drains in hand for time. Drs. now expecting to cut off at least one finger. Enro1- led last Thursday and now there is hope of saving even that. All drains now out but two.
28 Gowenlock ..
28 Mary (Mrs.) Rombalski - 46 - in Harper Hos. - semi-conscious - brain tuomer feared. - daughter away from sacraments five yrs.
Roy Hall - Cancer of side ...
Anna Otto - 42 - nerve trouble. ...
Henry Smith - blood transfusion
April 29th Mitchell Michael - 15 - Epileptic fits every day now for over a year. Had spinal maningitis when two yrs. old and paralized on his right side - can speak only a little.
29 Josephine Hollands - 44 - cancer operation last July - breast re- moved - now thought to be all through body. Drs. expected her death two months ago - sending her to Mercy Hall that her four children and (non Catholic usband)
1937, May
Page 184 May 3rd Eliz. Blay - 47 - has four children, has diabetes and going blind. Drs. say nothing can be done - in three months will be totally blind
Mrs. Wm. Quinn - 58 - had breast removed last Oct. She had fallen last May and hurt her breast and in October had it removed. In Feb. & March it was causing great anixiety when on April 9th she had her name inscribed in Sr. Mass A'n. At once it improved.
Mrs. Cath. Murphy - 81 - recovering from gangreenous foot etc. asks for prayers ....
3rd Mary Rombelski - 47 - in Harper's - Spinal trouble - unconscious since April 28th - enrolled To-day - 3rd time in 8 days.
